Hannah Torres: Hey folks — accepted the org invite earlier but I can see the org and some public repos, yet when I try to open our private onboarding repo `redwood/onboard-lab` it says "You don't have access". Clone gives permission denied. Who should I ask? :wave:
Priyanka Rao: Welcome Hannah! Quick checks: 1) Did you complete the SSO authorization? 2) Is 2FA enabled? 3) Which GitHub username are you using in your SSH key?
Hannah Torres: I did SSO and 2FA earlier today. My GH username is hannah-t. `ssh -T git@github.com` returns: "Hi hannah-t! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access."
infra-bot: Automated check: org membership = yes, SSO = authorized, 2FA = enabled, primary email = hannah@redwood.com (verified). Team assignments: parent team = engineers (GRANTED), child team `engineers/onboarding` = NOT FOUND.
Hannah Torres: Hmm I thought being in engineers would give access to onboarding repos.
Priyanka Rao: We use nested teams for permission scoping. Being in the parent doesn't always grant access to child-team-restricted repos if the child team has explicit permissions and our sync missed you. @Evan can you check the org team sync?
Evan Brooks: Looking in the org console — I see hannah-t mapped to engineers but there was a recent migration where child team IDs changed; auto-sync skipped a subset of members. Adding you directly to `engineers/onboarding` now.
Evan Brooks: Added. Try the repo URL now and attempt `git clone git@github.com:redwood/onboard-lab.git`.
Hannah Torres: Repo page loads, cloning... cloning successful, thanks! One quick question: I was able to view some private repos earlier but not this one — why the inconsistency?
Priyanka Rao: Some repos are granted at the parent team level and some are restricted to child teams for stricter onboarding controls. Migration artifacts can cause inconsistent mapping during invites. We try to catch these but sometimes a manual add is needed.
Hannah Torres: Got it. Also, when I try to push to my feature branch I get "remote: error: protected branch update rejected". Is main protected for this repo?
Evan Brooks: Yes, `main` is protected; we require PRs with 1 reviewer and passing CI. Push to a feature branch and open a PR.
Hannah Torres: Will do. Last tiny thing: my local commits show my personal email. How do I change that for future commits?
Priyanka Rao: Set your git email: `git config --global user.email "hannah@redwood.com"`. For existing commits: `git commit --amend --reset-author` then force-push to your branch. If you need help rewriting multiple commits ping me.
Hannah Torres: Thanks all — repo access sorted and PR opened. Appreciate the quick fix! :tada:
